scope: Workspace-wide Owner/Member status retains the first actual workspace membership capture and selects installations plus active repository links coherently. BrowserPrincipal remains identity/session only. No shared auth, Hub, schema, webhook, upsert, mapping or execution policy changed in this tested source.

clean_commands.counting: Stage cases/files count twenty-five Vitest invocation blocks, not unique totals. Dependencies, six panel browser cases and forty-one notification labels stay separate. Native counts are emitted top-level check labels, not nested assertions.
F1-F13 are thirteen unique scenarios; F8 emits two report lines but is counted once.

slice_suites.bounds_scope: Instrumented direct native domain status selections only; Worker/DO internals, setup, first principal captures, independent cuts and snapshots are excluded.
slice_suites.controls: Useful ordered Owner/Member DTOs and authorized empty arrays; direct internal reader retained. Restricted-project/no-grant Member audience is proved in domain/native controls. Mounted grant absence is not relabelled as a restricted-project control.
slice_suites.denials: Initial Reviewer getter denial; retained late epoch/removal/demotion and empty-status loss; explicitly synthetic membership reinstatement at the same still-revoked epoch.
slice_suites.coherence: One final statement returns current installation/link fields and an authority sentinel; no partial array survives a separate source change.
slice_suites.storage: Complete after-cut canonical snapshots unchanged, HTTP budgets separately unchanged, clean foreign keys and empty transient guards.

old_source_probes.canonical_snapshots: Taken after each completed independent cut; OLD outcomes and effects are collected before policy assertions.
old_source_probes.observed: OLD can deliver status after late membership/epoch/role loss and combine old installation fields with newer repository-link fields. Direct Reviewer failure concerns the getter; the browser already rejects Reviewers before source reads.
old_source_probes.excluded_exploratory_attempt: Two initial domain probes failed before their removal/reinstatement cuts because the fixture omitted FK-required project-access cleanup. An initial native cleanup called a nonexistent server method after collecting its outcomes. Neither exploratory fixture/cleanup failure supplies the final OLD counts.
old_source_probes.synthetic_boundaries: Isolated role changes and same-revoked-epoch reinstatement are explicit synthetic robustness controls, not proof that production role/rejoin commands omit epoch bumps.

local_iterations.scalar_candidate: Focused 92-case/six-file plus native ten-group and exact X04 checks passed locally. Before commit, official D1 row/value limits motivated replacing a whole-workspace scalar JSON projection with individual tagged rows; the scalar iteration is not clean acceptance.
local_iterations.tagged_candidate: Final individual-row candidate passed the same focused/native and exact X04 checks locally before committing. Only the unchanged committed pipeline above is clean acceptance.
local_iterations.d1_limits: Individual-row selection avoids imposing a new workspace-size ceiling through D1's 2,000,000-byte maximum string/BLOB/table-row limit. Each legitimate installation/link JSON object remains producer-bounded; JSON argument counts remain below the function limit.
